title: LG-LOGSQUARE165: squared-log quota with quasipolynomial samples and sharper time/quantum envelopes

claims.statement: For the single fixed uniform LG-LOGSQUARE165 physical algorithm supplied completely in proof.md and virtual.md (finite tester for ell=ceil(log2 n)<2^20; otherwise a=floor(log2 ell),u=ell²,V=u,h=2a-5,Ybar=ell²,K=8192*(8ell²+ell+30),f=2^h,y=ceil(V/(4h)),w=ceil(n/((f-h)y)),cbar=ell+6,q=f+ceil((f-1)*cbar/(w+1)), cumulative Aglob guard before each batched acquisition with threshold Ccap (original guards and old LE sizing retained), enlarged uniform-height MERGEG capacities, full-b-bit root flag/filter, exact source/cap guards, both full-modulus decoders and counted physical compiler), for every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), unconditional ENTIRE-secret success is at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. Jointly on EVERY branch T=O(2^(n/(log2 n)^(63/32))), ordinary classical workspace O(n), full allocated quantum workspace O(2^(n/(log2 n)^(127/32))), and total source acquisitions O(2^((283/1000)*(log2 n)^2)). Every failure, discard, partial attempt, source guard, retry, abort, initialization, finite exact epoch repair, full address debit, source move and cleanup is included with absolute outside constants and the exact displayed exponent coefficients. The corresponding upper envelope has exact index1.
